edges: Fainall informs Mirabell that should Lady Wishfort marry, he will lose £6000 of Millamant's inheritance.
Fainall accuses Mrs. Marwood of loving Mirabell.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Mirabell will lose £6000 of Millamant's inheritance if Lady Wishfort marries.
Mirabell is informed by a footman that Waitwell and Foible were married that morning.
Mirabell tells Fainall about his love for Millamant.
Foible encourages Lady Wishfort to marry Sir Rowland.
Fainall blackmails Lady Wishfort using information about Mrs. Fainall's affair with Mirabell.
Mirabell restores Mrs. Fainall's property to her possession.
Lady Wishfort wants Millamant to marry her nephew, Sir Wilfull Witwoud.
